The National Education Association (NEA) is more than 3 million people—educators, students, activists, workers, parents, neighbors, friends—who believe in opportunity for all students and in the power of public education to transform lives and create a more just and inclusive society.

s: The National Education Association (NEA) is the largest labor union in the United States, representing approximately three million members, including teachers from kindergarten to college, education support professionals, and retired educators. Founded in 1857 as the National Teachers Association, the NEA has evolved to advocate for educational professionals and the enhancement of public education.
